name: Montgomery County Young People’s of AA
notes:
Notes: Young Peoples Meeting hosted by the Montgomery County Bid Committee for PENNSCYPAA (PENNsylvania State Conference of Young People in AA). Meeting follows a rotating format, has info for upcoming YPAA events, current list of available sponsors in the area, and fellowshiping after meeting.
When we say young people, we mean anyone with room to grow. There is a rotating format. Please bring your own big book and consider donating big books or other AA approved literature. There will be a collection box at the meeting.
